title: Chipotle Ordering App
description: Wanting to make their loyal fans' lives better by making it easier than ever to order delicious food, Chipotle knew it was time to revisit their mobile presence and give customers a completely new experience.  Introducing the new Chipotle Ordering App: http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/chipotle-ordering/id327228455?mt=8  This essential iOS app brings the convenience of Chipotle's desktop ordering site to your phone—no need to be chained to your desk, anymore. The app was specifically designed to highlight simplicity and utility, and was inspired by Chipotle's world-renowned, lightning-fast service lines.  When an uncontrollable craving hits you, just pull out your device, build your custom masterpiece, and pay—all with the touch of a finger. The app will give you directions to the nearest Chipotle location, and then—no waiting in line. Walk in, pick up, and eat.  The Ordering app remembers your recent and favorite orders, payment methods, and all through your secure Chipotle.com account. Also new is the option to pay with your Chipotle gift card, as well as a credit card, or in-store.  To appeal to Chipotle customers around the world, we translated the app into French and Spanish, as well as launching it in three new countries: Canada, France, and the UK. The menu displays specific food items available by location, allowing for completely customizable meals, all over the world.  Bottom line: we made it easier and faster than ever to enjoy a sustainable, tasty meal wherever you are. And, fans couldn't be happier. Since launch, the Chipotle Ordering App has sat in the top five most popular Food apps in the App Store, and has seen over a million downloads, and counting.

asr.full_text: Chipotle is known as a company who prides itself on doing things differently. From delivering food with integrity to finding the very best ingredients raised with respect for the animals, the environment, and the farmers, Chipotle has remained dedicated to their mission of giving hungry burrito lovers the highest quality product and experience possible. With the world around us more mobile and connected than ever before, Chipotle knew it was time to revisit their mobile presence and give loyal customers a completely new app experience to make their lives better faster. Introducing the new and improved Chipotle ordering app! The premise is simple. Touch, Pick and Pay. No wandering the streets looking for closest Chipotle. No waiting in line feverishly checking your emails and texts. And No fumbling for cash and coins at register. Just whip out your phone, build your masterpiece, and pay with one touch of the finger. The app was specifically designed to highlight simplicity and utility and was inspired by Chipotle's world-renowned lightening fast service lines. We stripped away anything and everything that could get in the way to give users the options they asked for, and the best experience possible. The app also remembers your favorite orders and payment methods and even gives you directions to the newest location all through your secure Chipotle.com account. The menu displays specific items available by location, allowing for completely customizable meals all over the world. Since launch, the new Chipotle ordering app has sat in the top five most popular food apps in the app store and is also now available for the first time across four countries and three languages. Once news of the launch hit the web, things got a little crazy. From media outlets to social networks, fans everywhere took to their keyboards and phones to share their joy around the world. The people had spoken and they were happy, really happy. Food with integrity has never been easier to enjoy and at over a million downloads and counting, that's a lot of burritos.
